paragraph: **The** bus stopped near **the** library. I got off and looked for **the** main door.
english: used before a noun when you and the listener know which one you mean
arabicDesc: أداة تدخل على الاسم لتدل على أنه شيء معروف ومحدد

paragraph: I **am** tired today, but my brother **is** full of energy. We **were** at the beach all day yesterday.
english: used to say what someone or something is, or where it is
arabicDesc: فعل يصف حالة الشخص أو الشيء أو مكانه، وصيغه am وis وare وwas وwere

other.meaning: used with another verb to show an action in progress

paragraph: Every morning I walk **to** the station. Then I take the train **to** work and try **to** read a little.
english: showing the direction of movement; also used before a verb
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على الاتجاه أو الوصول إلى مكان، ويأتي قبل الفعل في صيغته الأساسية

other.meaning: used before a verb to show purpose

paragraph: I bought bread **and** cheese for lunch. My sister came over, **and** we ate together in the garden.
english: used to join words or ideas that go together
arabicDesc: حرف عطف يربط بين كلمتين أو جملتين

paragraph: She drank a cup **of** coffee at the end **of** the meeting. Most **of** the team had already left.
english: showing that something belongs to, is part of, or is connected with something
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على الجزء من الكل أو على الانتماء، ويقابل الإضافة في العربية كقولنا نهاية الاجتماع

paragraph: I saw **a** small cat outside my window. It was sitting on **a** chair and watching **a** bird.
english: used before a singular noun when you mean any one, not a particular one
arabicDesc: أداة تأتي قبل الاسم المفرد غير المحدد، وتقابل التنوين في قولنا رأيت قطةً

paragraph: My keys are **in** my bag. We live **in** a small town, and my birthday is **in** June.
english: inside something; also used with places and periods of time
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على وجود الشيء داخل مكان أو زمان

other.meaning: after a period of time from now
other.example: I will be back in ten minutes.

paragraph: **I** wake up early on weekdays. After breakfast, **I** call my mother, and then **I** start work.
english: the word you use to talk about yourself as the subject; always a capital letter
arabicDesc: ضمير يستخدمه المتكلم للإشارة إلى نفسه

paragraph: I made this cake **for** you. We waited **for** the doctor **for** almost an hour.
english: showing who receives something, the purpose of something, or how long it lasts
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على الشخص المستفيد أو الغرض من الشيء أو مدة حدوثه

other.meaning: showing a length of time
other.example: I lived there for two years.

paragraph: Do you see **that** tall building? I think **that** my uncle works there. **That** is why I know the area.
english: used to point to something farther away, or to join two parts of a sentence
arabicDesc: اسم إشارة للبعيد، ويستخدم أيضًا لربط جملتين بمعنى أنّ

other.meaning: used to give more information about a noun
other.example: The book that I bought is good.

paragraph: We **have** two cats at home. My neighbor **has** a dog, and it **had** puppies last spring.
english: to own something or to hold it as a part of you
arabicDesc: فعل يدل على امتلاك شيء أو وجوده عند الشخص

other.meaning: used with a past form to make perfect tenses
to eat or drink something

paragraph: Are **you** free on Friday? I can drive **you** to the airport if **you** need a ride.
english: the person or people someone is speaking to
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى الشخص أو الأشخاص الذين نخاطبهم

paragraph: I found a phone on the bus and gave **it** to the driver. **It** was raining when I got home.
english: used for a thing or animal already mentioned; also for weather and time
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى شيء أو حيوان، ويستخدم أيضًا عند الحديث عن الطقس والوقت

paragraph: I left the book **on** the table. We will talk about it **on** Monday, when you are back.
english: touching the top of something; also used with days
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على وجود الشيء فوق سطح، ويستخدم مع أيام الأسبوع والتواريخ

other.meaning: working or operating

paragraph: I went to the market **with** my father. He paid **with** cash and carried the bags **with** one hand.
english: together with someone or something; also using something
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على المصاحبة، أو على الأداة المستخدمة في الفعل

paragraph: **This** bag is mine. I bought it **this** morning, and I want to use it on **this** trip.
english: used to point to something near you, or to the present time
arabicDesc: اسم إشارة للقريب من المتكلم في المكان أو الزمان

paragraph: She works **as** a nurse at the city hospital. **As** I was leaving, she waved and smiled.
english: in the role of something; also at the same time that something happens
arabicDesc: يدل على الصفة أو الوظيفة بمعنى كـ، أو على حدوث أمرين في وقت واحد بمعنى بينما

other.meaning: used to compare two things that are equal
other.example: He is as tall as his father.

paragraph: Let's meet **at** the coffee shop **at** six. I will be **at** work until then.
english: showing an exact place or an exact time
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على نقطة محددة في المكان أو ساعة محددة في الزمان

paragraph: My brother is a pilot. **He** flies to Asia every month, and **he** always brings me a gift.
english: a man, boy or male animal already mentioned
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى الذكر الغائب الذي سبق ذكره

paragraph: I am **not** ready yet. Please do **not** leave without me, because I do **not** know the way.
english: used to make a sentence negative
arabicDesc: أداة نفي تجعل معنى الجملة منفيًا

paragraph: We sat **by** the river for an hour. The photo was taken **by** my sister, and we went home **by** bus.
english: near something; also showing who does an action or how it is done
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على القرب من الشيء، أو على من قام بالفعل، أو على الوسيلة

other.meaning: not later than a certain time

paragraph: What did you **do** last weekend? I **did** my homework, and then I helped my mother in the kitchen.
english: to perform an action or a piece of work
arabicDesc: فعل يعني القيام بعمل أو نشاط ما

other.meaning: used to make questions and negatives

paragraph: The food was cheap **but** very good. I wanted dessert, **but** I was already full.
english: used to join two ideas that are different or surprising together
arabicDesc: حرف يربط بين فكرتين مختلفتين ويدل على الاستدراك

paragraph: This letter is **from** my aunt. She moved **from** Jordan to Canada, and she works **from** nine to five.
english: showing where something starts or where someone comes from
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على نقطة البداية في المكان أو الزمان، أو على مصدر الشيء

paragraph: **My** office is close to **my** home. I walk there with **my** best friend most days.
english: belonging to me
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص المتكلم، مثل الياء في كتابي

paragraph: Would you like tea **or** coffee? We can sit inside **or** go out to the garden.
english: used to show a choice between two or more things
arabicDesc: حرف عطف يدل على الاختيار بين شيئين أو أكثر

paragraph: **We** moved to this city last year. Now **we** know our neighbors, and **we** feel at home.
english: the speaker together with one or more other people
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى المتكلم ومن معه

paragraph: I ate **an** apple on the way to work. It took **an** hour because of **an** accident on the road.
english: the form of 'a' used before a vowel sound
arabicDesc: صيغة من a تأتي قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت متحرك

paragraph: Is this **your** coat? Please write **your** name on the form and give it to **your** teacher.
english: belonging to the person or people you are speaking to
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص المخاطب، مثل الكاف في كتابك

paragraph: **All** the students passed the test. We celebrated **all** night and talked about **all** our plans.
english: the whole of something, or every one of a group
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على الشيء كاملًا أو على جميع أفراد المجموعة

paragraph: It was **so** hot yesterday. The air conditioner broke, **so** we went to the mall to cool down.
english: very, to a great degree; also used to show a result
arabicDesc: تدل على شدة الصفة بمعنى جدًا، وتربط السبب بالنتيجة بمعنى لذلك

paragraph: I need to **get** some milk on my way home. If I **get** there early, I can **get** a good parking spot.
english: to obtain or receive something
arabicDesc: فعل يعني نيل الشيء أو الحصول عليه أو شراءه

other.meaning: to arrive at a place
to become

paragraph: Ali lost **his** wallet at the gym. **His** sister found it in **his** car the next day.
english: belonging to a man or boy already mentioned
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص الذكر الغائب، مثل الهاء في كتابه

paragraph: My cousins came to visit. **They** stayed for a week, and **they** want to come back in summer.
english: two or more people or things already mentioned
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى جماعة الغائبين من الأشخاص أو الأشياء

paragraph: I have only **one** brother. He has two cars, and he lets me use **one** when I visit.
english: the number 1; a single person or thing
arabicDesc: العدد 1، ويدل أيضًا على شخص أو شيء مفرد

other.meaning: used instead of repeating a noun

paragraph: Can you help **me** with this box? My friend gave it to **me**, and it is too heavy for **me**.
english: the person speaking, when not the subject of the sentence
arabicDesc: ضمير يدل على المتكلم حين يقع عليه الفعل، مثل النون والياء في ساعدني

paragraph: **If** it rains tomorrow, we will stay home. Call me **if** you change your mind.
english: used to say that something depends on something else
arabicDesc: أداة شرط تربط حدوث أمر بحدوث أمر آخر

other.meaning: used to ask or report a yes/no question
other.example: I don't know if he is coming.

paragraph: My daughter **can** swim very well. She **can** also speak three languages, and I **can** only speak two.
english: to be able to do something, or to be allowed to
arabicDesc: فعل مساعد يدل على القدرة على فعل شيء أو السماح به

other.meaning: a metal container for food or drink

paragraph: I **will** call you tonight. The weather **will** be better tomorrow, so we **will** go for a walk.
english: used to talk about the future
arabicDesc: فعل مساعد يدل على أن الأمر سيحدث في المستقبل

other.meaning: the strong desire to do something
other.example: She has the will to win.

paragraph: I **like** quiet places with good coffee. My wife **likes** the sea, so we go there in the summer.
english: to enjoy something or think it is good
arabicDesc: فعل يعني أن الشيء يعجب الإنسان ويشعر نحوه بالرضا

other.meaning: similar to

paragraph: I **just** finished my lunch. It was **just** a sandwich, but it was enough for now.
english: only, or a very short time ago
arabicDesc: تدل على الاقتصار بمعنى فقط، أو على حدوث الأمر قبل قليل بمعنى للتو

other.meaning: fair and right

paragraph: My mother taught me how to **make** bread. Now I **make** it every Friday, and it **makes** the whole house smell good.
english: to create or produce something
arabicDesc: فعل يعني إنتاج شيء أو إعداده

other.meaning: to cause someone to do or feel something

paragraph: This is a **good** restaurant. The food is fresh, the price is fair, and the staff are **good** to their customers.
english: of high quality or pleasant; the opposite of bad
arabicDesc: صفة تدل على أن الشيء ذو جودة أو نافع أو مُرضٍ

other.meaning: able to do something well

paragraph: I **go** to the gym three times a week. Yesterday I **went** after work, and my friend **went** with me.
english: to move or travel from one place to another
arabicDesc: فعل يعني الانتقال من مكان إلى مكان آخر

other.meaning: used with -ing for future plans: going to

paragraph: We talked **about** the new project. It will take **about** three months to finish.
english: on the subject of something; also approximately
arabicDesc: تدل على موضوع الكلام بمعنى عن، أو على التقريب بمعنى حوالي

paragraph: We climbed **up** the hill before sunrise. At the top, I looked **up** and saw the last stars.
english: toward a higher place
arabicDesc: تدل على الحركة أو الاتجاه نحو مكان مرتفع

other.meaning: used in phrasal verbs, often meaning completely
other.arabic: تكمل معنى الفعل، مثل التنظيف الكامل

paragraph: I went **out** for a walk after dinner. When I came back, my key fell **out** of my pocket.
english: away from the inside of a place or thing
arabicDesc: تدل على الحركة من الداخل إلى الخارج أو على عدم الوجود في المكان

paragraph: **What** is your favorite food? Tell me **what** you want, and I will order it for you.
english: used to ask about a thing, or to mean the thing that
arabicDesc: أداة استفهام عن الأشياء، وتأتي أيضًا بمعنى الشيء الذي

paragraph: **When** does the shop open? I usually go there **when** I finish work.
english: used to ask about the time, or to say at what time something happens
arabicDesc: أداة استفهام عن الزمان بمعنى متى، أو رابط زمني بمعنى عندما

paragraph: What did the doctor **say**? He **said** that I should rest, and he **says** I will feel better soon.
english: to speak words
arabicDesc: فعل يعني النطق بكلام أو التعبير عنه

paragraph: I never have enough **time** in the morning. What **time** does your train leave today?
english: what we measure in minutes, hours and days
arabicDesc: المدة التي تقاس بالدقائق والساعات والأيام

other.meaning: an occasion when something happens
other.example: I saw that film three times.

paragraph: I need **more** time to finish this. Can you give me **more** details about the job?
english: a larger amount or number
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على كمية أو عدد أكبر من السابق

paragraph: There is **no** milk in the fridge. **No**, I did not buy any, because the shop was closed.
english: not any; also the opposite answer to yes
arabicDesc: كلمة للنفي أو للإجابة بالرفض، وتدل على عدم وجود الشيء

paragraph: **Who** is that man at the door? He is the engineer **who** fixed our heater last year.
english: used to ask about a person, or to give more information about a person
arabicDesc: أداة استفهام عن الأشخاص بمعنى من، أو اسم موصول بمعنى الذي

paragraph: The children took off **their** shoes. **Their** mother asked them to wash **their** hands before dinner.
english: belonging to the people or things already mentioned
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص جماعة الغائبين، مثل هم في كتابهم

paragraph: **There** is a small park near my house. I go **there** every evening to relax.
english: in that place; also used to say that something exists
arabicDesc: تدل على مكان بعيد عن المتكلم، وتستخدم للقول إن الشيء موجود

paragraph: Sara called **her** mother last night. I saw **her** at the store and gave **her** the book.
english: belonging to a woman or girl; also that woman or girl when not the subject
arabicDesc: تدل على أن الشيء يخص المؤنث الغائب، مثل الهاء في كتابها، أو على من يقع عليها الفعل

paragraph: **Which** bag is yours? I bought the blue one, **which** was on sale last week.
english: used to ask for a choice among things, or to add information about a thing
arabicDesc: أداة استفهام للاختيار بمعنى أي، أو اسم موصول لغير العاقل بمعنى الذي

paragraph: I can **see** the mountains from my window. Yesterday I **saw** a deer near the road.
english: to notice something with your eyes
arabicDesc: فعل يعني إدراك الشيء بالعين

other.meaning: to understand
to meet or visit

paragraph: I **would** love to visit Japan one day. **Would** you like to come with me if I go?
english: used for imagined situations and polite requests
arabicDesc: فعل مساعد يدل على أمر مفترض، ويستخدم في الطلب المهذب

paragraph: Do you **know** this song? I **knew** all the words when I was a child.
english: to have information in your mind; to be familiar with someone
arabicDesc: فعل يعني امتلاك المعلومة أو معرفة شخص أو شيء

paragraph: My son starts school next **year**. This **year** he learned to read, and we are very proud.
english: a period of twelve months
arabicDesc: مدة زمنية تتكون من اثني عشر شهرًا

paragraph: My sister is a doctor. **She** works at night, so **she** sleeps during the day.
english: a woman, girl or female animal already mentioned
arabicDesc: ضمير يشير إلى المؤنث الغائب الذي سبق ذكره

paragraph: I bought a **new** phone last week. It has a **new** camera, and it takes great photos.
english: recently made, bought or started
arabicDesc: صفة تدل على أن الشيء صُنع أو بدأ حديثًا

paragraph: Many **people** were waiting at the bus stop. Some **people** were reading, and others were looking at their phones.
english: men, women and children; more than one person
arabicDesc: مجموعة من الأشخاص من الرجال والنساء والأطفال

other.meaning: a nation or community

paragraph: Please **take** an umbrella with you. It will **take** about an hour to get there, and it may rain.
english: to carry or move something with you
arabicDesc: فعل يعني إمساك الشيء أو حمله معك من مكان إلى آخر

other.meaning: to need an amount of time

paragraph: **How** did you learn English so fast? Please show me **how** you study.
english: in what way; also used to ask about amount or condition
arabicDesc: أداة استفهام عن الطريقة أو الحال

other.meaning: used with much or many to ask about amount

paragraph: I like this shirt, but I want to try the **other** one. **Other** colors are in the back of the store.
english: different from the one already mentioned; the remaining one
arabicDesc: صفة تدل على شيء مختلف عن المذكور أو على الباقي منه

paragraph: Can I **use** your pen for a minute? I **used** mine all morning, and now it is empty.
english: to do something with a tool or thing for a purpose
arabicDesc: فعل يعني الاستفادة من شيء لتحقيق غرض ما

other.meaning: used to: something that was true in the past

paragraph: I bought **some** fruit at the market. **Some** of it was for my neighbor, who is ill.
english: an amount or number, but not all and not exact
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على كمية أو عدد غير محدد

paragraph: She speaks Arabic and French. She **also** studied German, and she is **also** learning Korean now.
english: in addition; too
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على إضافة معلومة إلى ما سبق

paragraph: I met my cousins and invited **them** for dinner. I cooked for **them**, and I told **them** about my trip.
english: two or more people or things, when not the subject
arabicDesc: ضمير يدل على جماعة الغائبين حين يقع عليهم الفعل، مثل دعوتهم

paragraph: My father **works** in a bank. He starts **work** at eight, and he enjoys what he does.
english: to do a job or an activity that needs effort
arabicDesc: فعل يعني أداء وظيفة أو بذل جهد في مهمة

other.meaning: to function correctly
a job or place of employment (noun)

paragraph: I **want** a cup of tea. My friend **wants** to go home because she has a headache.
english: to wish to have or do something
arabicDesc: فعل يعني الرغبة في الحصول على شيء أو فعله

paragraph: I am busy right **now**, so please call later. I was tired before, but **now** I feel fine.
english: at this moment
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على الوقت الحاضر

paragraph: I **think** this is the right road. Let me **think** for a moment and check the map.
english: to have an opinion; to use your mind
arabicDesc: فعل يعني إعمال العقل، أو أن يكون للشخص رأي في أمر ما

paragraph: Please **come** to my house on Saturday. My brother **came** last week and stayed for dinner.
english: to move toward the speaker or a place
arabicDesc: فعل يعني التحرك نحو مكان المتكلم أو الوصول إليه

paragraph: The cat licked **its** paws. This company has **its** main office in Riyadh.
english: belonging to a thing or animal already mentioned
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص حيوانًا أو شيئًا، ولا تكتب بالفاصلة العليا

paragraph: **Our** teacher gave us a long test. We finished **our** work and handed in **our** papers.
english: belonging to the speaker and others
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على أن الشيء يخص المتكلم ومن معه، مثل كتابنا

paragraph: **Look** at that beautiful sky. You **look** tired, so sit down and enjoy the view.
english: to turn your eyes toward something; also to seem
arabicDesc: فعل يعني توجيه النظر إلى شيء، أو أن يظهر الشخص أو الشيء بمظهر معين

other.meaning: look for: to try to find

paragraph: My brother is taller **than** me. He also runs faster **than** anyone in our family.
english: used to compare two people or things
arabicDesc: كلمة تأتي بعد صيغة المقارنة، كقولنا أطول من

paragraph: I **need** a new passport before my trip. You **need** two photos, and you must fill in a form.
english: to have to have something because it is important
arabicDesc: فعل يعني أن الشيء ضروري للشخص ولا يمكنه الاستغناء عنه

paragraph: I have **only** ten minutes for lunch. She is the **only** person in the office today.
english: no more than; also the single one
arabicDesc: تدل على الحصر بمعنى فقط، أو على أن الشيء لا ثاني له بمعنى الوحيد

paragraph: It was a long **day** at the office. Tomorrow is my **day** off, so I can sleep late.
english: a period of 24 hours; the time when it is light
arabicDesc: مدة أربع وعشرين ساعة، أو الوقت من طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها

paragraph: This is my **first** visit to Cairo. **First** I want to see the old city, and then the river.
english: coming before all others
arabicDesc: صفة تدل على الشيء الذي يأتي قبل غيره في الترتيب أو الزمن

paragraph: We went for a walk **after** dinner. **After** that, we watched a film and went to bed.
english: following something in time or order
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على ما يلي شيئًا في الزمان أو الترتيب

paragraph: I saw Omar and said hello to **him**. I gave **him** the keys and asked **him** to lock the door.
english: a man or boy, when not the subject of the sentence
arabicDesc: ضمير يدل على الذكر الغائب حين يقع عليه الفعل، مثل رأيته

paragraph: She walked **into** the room and put her phone **into** her bag. Then she sat down.
english: moving to the inside of something
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على الحركة من الخارج إلى داخل الشيء

other.meaning: showing a change from one thing to another

paragraph: I have **two** sisters and one brother. We meet **two** times a year at our parents' home.
english: the number 2
arabicDesc: العدد 2

paragraph: A plane flew **over** our house. The lesson was **over** in an hour, and **over** twenty students came.
english: above something; also finished, or more than
arabicDesc: حرف يدل على ارتفاع الشيء فوق غيره دون أن يلمسه، أو على تجاوز عدد معين

other.meaning: finished

paragraph: Please **give** this letter to your manager. She **gave** me her number so that I can call her.
english: to hand something to someone or let them have it
arabicDesc: فعل يعني تسليم شيء لشخص أو جعله يحصل عليه

paragraph: Do you have **any** questions? There are not **any** seats left, but you can come **any** day next week.
english: some, in questions and negatives; also no matter which
arabicDesc: كلمة تدل على مقدار غير محدد في السؤال والنفي، أو على أي واحد دون تحديد

paragraph: Finish your homework, **then** you can play. I lived in Amman **then**, but I moved later.
english: after that; also at that time
arabicDesc: تدل على الترتيب بمعنى ثم، أو على وقت معين في الماضي أو المستقبل بمعنى حينئذ

paragraph: I can't **find** my glasses anywhere. Yesterday I **found** them under the sofa.
english: to discover something you were looking for
arabicDesc: فعل يعني العثور على شيء بعد البحث عنه أو بالمصادفة

other.meaning: to have an opinion after experiencing something

paragraph: I **could** swim when I was five. **Could** you open the window, please? It **could** rain later.
english: past of can; also used for polite requests and possibility
arabicDesc: ماضي can، ويستخدم في الطلب المهذب وللدلالة على الاحتمال

paragraph: I will be **back** in five minutes. My **back** hurts, so I need to sit down when I come **back**.
english: returning to an earlier place or state
arabicDesc: تدل على الرجوع إلى المكان أو الحال السابقة

other.meaning: the part of your body behind you (noun)

paragraph: Is this the **way** to the station? There is an easier **way** to get there by bus.
english: a road or direction; also a method of doing something
arabicDesc: المسار المؤدي إلى مكان، أو الأسلوب الذي يتم به فعل شيء

paragraph: **These** apples are very sweet. I bought them at the market, and **these** days they are cheap.
english: used to point to things near you; plural of this
arabicDesc: اسم إشارة للجمع القريب من المتكلم

paragraph: Our manager took **us** to lunch. She told **us** about the plan and thanked **us** for our work.
english: the speaker and others, when not the subject
arabicDesc: ضمير يدل على المتكلم ومن معه حين يقع عليهم الفعل، مثل ساعدنا

paragraph: She speaks English very **well**. I did not sleep **well** last night, but I am **well** enough to work.
english: in a good or correct way
arabicDesc: تصف الفعل بأنه تم بطريقة جيدة أو صحيحة

other.meaning: in good health
a deep hole for getting water (noun)
